title: Implement interval scheduling algorithms in Python
description: Greenfield Python task: implement merge_intervals (merge overlapping intervals), max_non_overlapping (max count of non-overlapping intervals via greedy earliest-end), and is_covered (check if target interval is fully covered by union of intervals).

required_artifacts: merge_intervals sorts by start and merges overlapping spans
is_covered returns False when gap exists in coverage
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (5 tests)
uv run python -c "from src.intervals import merge_intervals, max_non_overlapping, is_covered" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.intervals import merge_intervals, max_non_overlapping, is_covered"
